name.title: Site key
name.description: Stable site identifier used in beacon URLs and history. Renaming creates a new history identity.

display_name.title: Display name
display_name.description: Human-readable site name. Leave empty to use the site key.

allowed_origins.title: Allowed origins
allowed_origins.description: Web origins allowed to send telemetry, such as https://example.org. A leading *. allows subdomains only.

public_url.title: Public URL
public_url.description: Externally reachable collector base URL for this site. Leave empty to use the receiver public URL.

window.title: Measurement window
window.description: Sliding window for browser measurements. Accepts durations between 1m and 30m.

page_groups.title: Page groups
page_groups.description: Maximum individual page groups shown in breakdown charts. Remaining groups are combined as other.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Maximum individual countries shown in breakdown charts. Remaining countries are combined as other.

collect_console_logs.title: Collect console logs
collect_console_logs.description: Export browser console logs through OTLP for investigated sessions.

measure_sample_rate.title: Measure sample rate
measure_sample_rate.description: Share of browser sessions measured, from 0 to 1. Zero preserves the default of measuring all sessions.

investigate.title: Investigation sampling
investigate.description: Choose which measured sessions retain full history. Leave empty to retain all sessions.

sample_rate.title: Investigation sample rate
sample_rate.description: Share of measured sessions kept in full, from 0 to 1. Zero means all sessions.

always_keep.title: Always keep
always_keep.description: Conditions that retain a session regardless of sampling. Leave unset to keep errors and poor vitals; an empty list keeps neither.

bots.title: Bot handling
bots.description: Exclude crawlers and browser automation by default, or include them as bot traffic.

tracing.title: Browser tracing
tracing.description: Follow browser requests into backend services. Leave empty to disable tracing.

enabled.title: Enable tracing
enabled.description: Capture browser request spans and propagate trace headers.

propagate_to.title: Trace propagation origins
propagate_to.description: Additional API origins receiving trace headers. Same-origin requests receive them automatically.

export_to.title: Span export destination
export_to.description: OTLP gRPC host:port or https://host:port. Leave empty to use this site OTLP endpoint.

redact_paths.title: Path redaction
redact_paths.description: Replace private identifiers in URL paths before aggregation and export. Rules run before built-in path redaction.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Go regular expression matching private path identifiers. Empty patterns are ignored.

replace.title: Replacement
replace.description: Replacement text for matching path segments. Leave empty to remove them.

otlp.title: OTLP export
otlp.description: Export browser logs and spans to an OTLP gRPC receiver.

enabled.title: Log export
enabled.description: Auto exports to an available receiver; yes enables export, and no disables log export. Export failures do not stop ingestion.

endpoint.title: OTLP endpoint
endpoint.description: OTLP gRPC host and port for logs and default browser span export.

auth_token.title: Authentication token
auth_token.description: Bearer token sent to the OTLP receiver. Leave empty for no authentication.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Client certificate file. Leave empty with TLS key to omit client authentication.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Client private key file. Set together with TLS certificate.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA certificate
tls_ca.description: CA certificate file for verifying the OTLP receiver. Leave empty to use system roots when TLS is enabled.
